title: 云岑亭 Yuncen Ting
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.48 m, eave 3.68 m, ridge 5.28 m above the ground
by the hall kit: 1 bay, steps on the front, 攒尖 pyramid, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 碧桐书院
evidence.excerpt_zh: 由五福堂渡河而北山阜旋繞内為碧桐書院前宇三楹正殿五楹後照殿五楹其西巖石上為雲岑亭（圓明園冊）臣等謹按碧桐書院四十景之一也額為世宗御書㳟懸正殿内
evidence.summary: North across the stream from 五福堂, ringed by low hills: 碧桐書院 with a three-bay front range, a five-bay main hall and a five-bay rear hall, and 雲岑亭 on the rock to the west.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label: a building stood here, its name unknown.
